blogPosts.title: Architecting Zero-Hallucination Enterprise RAG Pipelines
blogPosts.excerpt: A deep dive into hybrid lexical-dense vector retrieval, reciprocal rank fusion (RRF), and citation grounding for production knowledge assistants.
blogPosts.author: NIYAN Engineering Team
blogPosts.content:
Enterprise knowledge retrieval requires more than basic embedding similarity search. In production, vanilla vector retrieval frequently fails on alphanumeric codes, part numbers, and precise compliance language...

### 1. Hybrid Search Architecture
By combining dense semantic vectors (e.g., text-embedding-3-large) with sparse lexical algorithms (BM25) using Reciprocal Rank Fusion, systems capture both conceptual meaning and exact keyword hits.

### 2. Guardrails and Strict Rejection Prompts
Rather than forcing the LLM to speculate, configure explicit guardrail policies where the model must refuse when context similarity scores fall below threshold.

blogPosts.title: React Native vs Flutter in 2026: An Architecture-First Comparison
blogPosts.excerpt: Evaluating performance, community ecosystem, native bridging, and developer velocity for mobile startup engineering.
blogPosts.author: NIYAN Mobile Practice
blogPosts.content:
Selecting a mobile framework in 2026 is no longer about raw FPS debates—both Flutter and React Native (with the New Architecture, TurboModules, and Fabric renderer) achieve flawless 60 to 120 FPS performance...

### Key Decision Criteria
- If your team has deep TypeScript/React expertise, React Native with Expo offers unmatched code sharing between web and mobile.
- If you require bespoke canvas rendering, pixel-identical custom widgets, or complex graphics, Flutter remains a formidable choice.

blogPosts.title: Mastering the Final Year Engineering Project: From Concept to IEEE Viva
blogPosts.excerpt: How undergraduate engineering scholars can bridge theoretical concepts with real-world open source code to build genuine defense-ready projects.
blogPosts.author: Academic Solutions Group
blogPosts.content:
Engineering capstone projects often suffer from two extremes: either generic copy-paste projects that examiners immediately dismantle, or over-ambitious concepts that never reach a working prototype...

### Formulating a Valid Research Question
A strong project begins with a clear baseline comparison. Document what existing literature accomplishes, identify a specific bottleneck, and test a verifiable hypothesis with clear metrics.
